name: Scoreboard UI
summary: Sports-style score bug with two team names, two scores that can tick up, and a period and clock box.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; the bug is 918×150 at s = 1

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: color
params.note: home score colour; default the style's accent

params.name: home
params.note: home team name, keep it short

params.name: away
params.note: away team name, keep it short

author: krakujs
